basic_details.job_title: IIT Roorkee Project Assistant (Computer Science & Engineering) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Computer Science & Engineering at the Indian Institute of Technology, Roorkee has advertised one Project Assistant (Admin) position on the research project "A post quantum secure ZKP-based Authentication Protocol for connected and autonomous vehicles", sponsored by the Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology, New Delhi. The pay is Rs. 25000 + HRA for 2 years. The essential qualification is B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science/Information Technology/Electronics Communications or equivalent. Only Indian nationals can apply, by email to [email protected], by 18 November 2026

qualification.details: Preference will be given to candidates with experience in autonomous vehicles, UAVs, sensor integration, LLMs, basic hardware. Familiarity with tools such as Gazebo, SITL, Arduino IDE, Python, C++ will be an added advantage. Candidates should have good problem-solving skills, and an interest in implementation and development of both hardware and software of autonomous systems. Domain experience in robotic vehicles and UAVs will be given more preference. | Candidates must ensure before appearing for the interview that they are eligible for the position they intend to apply for. Candidates should read the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

how_to_apply: Prepare the application with the CV, degree certificates and experience certificates.
Send the application by email to [email protected].
Make sure it is submitted by 18 November 2026, 11:59 PM, the last date for applications to the office of the Principal Investigator.
Bring the original degree(s)/certificate(s) and experience certificate(s) to the interview for verification.
The notice does not give an email subject line.
important_instructions: No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview. Applications from Indian nationals only are invited. Original degree and experience certificates must be brought at the time of interview.

content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee Project Assistant (Admin) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit, the application fee or the interview date.

rows.details: A post quantum secure ZKP-based Authentication Protocol for connected and autonomous vehicles
Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology, New Delhi

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Indian nationals only. Preference will be given to candidates with experience in autonomous vehicles, UAVs, sensor integration, LLMs, basic hardware. Familiarity with tools such as Gazebo, SITL, Arduino IDE, Python, C++ will be an added advantage. Candidates should have good problem-solving skills, and an interest in implementation and development of both hardware and software of autonomous systems. Domain experience in robotic vehicles and UAVs will be given more preference. Candidates must ensure before appearing for the interview that they are eligible for the position they intend to apply for. Candidates should read the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

rows.essential_qualification: B.E./B.Tech in the field of Computer Science/Information Technology/Electronics Communications or equivalent.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emoluments are printed as Rs. 25000 + HRA, and the duration of the position is 2 Years. The notice prints no other allowance.

content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee Project Assistant (Admin) Job Description
content_sections.text: The Project Assistant position will require the candidate to have expertise in hardware components such as ESP32, STM32, NVIDIA Jetson and other such devices. The candidate should also have a good grasp over a programming language such as Python or C++.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Roorkee Project Assistant (Admin)
content_sections.text: Prepare the application with the CV, degree certificates and experience certificates. Send the application by email to [email protected] . Make sure it is submitted by 18 November 2026, 11:59 PM, the last date for applications to the office of the Principal Investigator. Bring the original degree(s)/certificate(s) and experience certificate(s) to the interview for verification. The notice does not give an email subject line.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to appear for the interview must first submit their applications by email. Originals of degree and experience certificates are verified at the time of the interview. Preference will be given to SC/ST candidates on equal qualifications and experience. The notice does not state an interview date or venue.

rows.event: Last date to submit application by email

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview. Applications from Indian nationals only are invited. Original degree and experience certificates must be brought at the time of interview.
